recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future actual-vs-estimated age semantics should be handled by a new Patient Care decision that explicitly revisits FHIR-54457.
issue_request: FHIR-10008 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2. It requested a FamilyMemberHistory boolean to distinguish estimated/approximate age from actual age and a corresponding update to the FamilyMemberHistory.age definition.
initial_application: The Jira comment's SVN #9053 corresponds to git commit 02ef67eba5476f3a28aa2f3d18efa6afe7c8eadb, which added FamilyMemberHistory.estimatedAge, missing-meaning text, and an fhs-2 invariant tying the flag to age[x].
additional_context: FHIR-54457 was later Applied for R6 with Patient Care's decision to remove FamilyMemberHistory.estimatedAge because Range can express approximation and exact-vs-estimated age was not clinically actionable. The combined branch already contains 6202fac1e4fd705975023b7b58a46535f99ccf25 for that removal. FHIR-52939 provides supporting Patient Care rationale on estimate precision but is an FHIR-extensions issue.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit for FHIR-10008. Reintroducing estimatedAge or an equivalent flag would conflict with the later final FHIR-54457 removal decision; active source no longer exposes estimatedAge except in commented historical text.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied Patient Care decision removed FamilyMemberHistory.estimatedAge; it is already represented on the combined branch by 6202fac1e4fd705975023b7b58a46535f99ccf25.
